Brawler Vez is a goblin in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two next to  Kansif and  Warrior Gronag if they are led there by  Sharp-Eye Lora.
“
Didn't figure something as big and ugly as you for a coward.
„
— Vez, to Kar'niss

Involvement

Act Two

If the party decide to be escorted by  Kar'niss to Moonrise Towers, Vez accompanies the party. If not, she later journeys to Moonrise Towers and is next to Gronag and Lora.
